appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Theme, color, density, font and zoom for the app.

theme.title: Theme
theme.scheduleDescription: When to switch between light and dark.

density.title: Density
density.rowSpacingDescription: Compact saves space. Comfortable improves readability.

font.title: Font
font.label: Interface typography
font.description: System uses SF Pro on macOS. Mono recommended for queries.

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.description: Applies to menus, settings, and system messages.

security.title: Security
security.biometrySupported: Touch ID / Face ID detected on this device.
security.biometryUnsupported: This device does not expose compatible biometry.
security.forgetLabel: Sign out and wipe local bearer
security.forgetDescription: Removes the token from the keychain and signs you out. You will need to reconfigure the org on next launch.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.exportDescription: Download a JSON with your profile, connections and orgs (no decrypted secrets).
danger.deleteDescription: Removes your account from the sync server. This action can't be undone.

auth.requiredBody: To access {{name}} you must authenticate. This organization requires OAuth.
auth.noProviders: This server has no OAuth providers configured. Ask the admin to add GITHUB_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / etc to the server's .env.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: To get started, pick where your data should live: on this machine or in a remote organization.
welcome.localBody: Spin up an embedded server on this machine. Your data stays here.
welcome.remoteBody: Join a self-hosted server shared with your team.
welcome.portHelp: Defaults to 18787. Change if it's already in use.
welcome.persistentLabel: Keep the server running when the app closes

offline.title: Server unreachable
offline.body: Cannot reach the server for {{name}}. Retry or check the configuration.

migration.title: Important migration
migration.body: This version changes how data is stored: everything now lives on a server (local or remote). Connections, groups and credentials saved locally will be wiped. Download an export before continuing.

inspector.empty: Select a table, query or connection to see details here.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sync your connections, folders and credentials across machines. The app works without login.
login.orgFlowHint: Login is per-organization. Add one to authenticate against its server.

workspace.title: Active workspace
workspace.empty: No connections in this workspace. Create one to get started.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.newConnectionDescription: Connect to PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Redis.
quickActions.importDescription: Load a previously saved JSON file.

runtime.title: Plugin runtime
runtime.description: Pick where the plugin runs when issuing queries: in your app (local subprocess) or on the server (REST proxy).
runtime.label: Run on the server
runtime.clientHint: OFF: each query spawns the plugin on this machine. Lower latency, credentials touch the client.
runtime.serverHint: ON: the server runs the plugin and returns results over HTTP. Credentials never leave the server, higher latency.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Database drivers. Enable, reload or sync with your organization.
plugins.select: Select a plugin to see details.

sync.title: Server plugins
sync.subtitle: Plugins distributed by the active organization.
sync.empty: The server does not publish any plugins.
sync.noOrg: No active organization with a server.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.subtitle: Encrypted server-side, shared with your organization.
credentials.select: Select a credential to see details.

empty.title: No credentials
empty.body: Create your first reusable credential. It is encrypted server-side on save.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete credential?
deleteConfirm.body: {{name}} will no longer be available. Linked connections will lose the link and need to be reconfigured.

connections.confirmDeleteDescription: Shows a confirmation dialog when removing a connection.
connections.autoConnectDescription: Connects immediately when clicking a saved connection.
connections.showBadgesDescription: Numeric badges with item counts per folder.
connections.restoreLastSessionDescription: Restores open tabs the next time you start the app.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.subtitle: Connect to self-hosted servers to share connections, credentials and plugins.
orgs.empty: You don't have any organizations yet. Add one to get started.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete organization?
deleteConfirm.body: {{name}} and all its local data will be removed from this machine. The remote server is not affected.

orgs.select: Select an organization on the left to see details.

members.title: {{name}} · Members
members.inviteShare: Share this link. Valid for {{ttl}}h and single-use.

wizard.title: Add organization
wizard.stepInput: Enter the server IP or domain.
wizard.noProviders: Server does not expose OAuth providers.
wizard.noProvidersBlock: Login required — server exposes no OAuth providers.
wizard.selectProvider: Pick a provider to sign in to {{name}}.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Customize shortcuts. Changes apply on app restart.

notes.rebindHelp: This action uses the OS shortcut and cannot be modified.
notes.restartRequired: Some changes require restarting the app.

localServer.title: Local server
localServer.subtitle: Embedded daemon. Your data lives here; the client never touches disk.

config.title: Configuration
config.portHint: Takes effect after restarting the server.
config.lanHint: Bind 0.0.0.0 + self-signed TLS. Allows access from other devices on your network.
config.autostartHint: Persistent daemon via LaunchAgent (macOS), systemd-user (Linux) or Task Scheduler (Windows).

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Upload a plugin binary (.so/.dylib/.dll) to the local server directory.
plugins.uploadHint: Plugin lands in plugins/ on the local server and shows up after a rescan.
plugins.serverStoppedHint: Start the server to upload plugins.

toasts.tokenWarnBody: Autostart uses the current token. Restart the server to reflect changes.
